label: Kodex logical-unit research profile
notes: The total is an architecture budget, not a claim that 264192 trained neurons are already running.
This profile has no trained weights and cannot independently generate intelligent predictions.
A future implementation must define sparse connectivity, memory cost, tokenizer, objective, datasets, training process, checkpoints and evaluations.
Do not allocate a fully dense weight matrix from this profile: its hidden dimensions are intentionally only a planning target.
